$comment: CANONICAL RULE REGISTRY — AI Reproductive Health Triage Assistant V2. Reconciled column-for-column against matrix_snapshot_v0.1.0.json (26 columns x 10 rules). The rule set was built by the CareBridge development team from publicly available medical guidance; it is NOT_CLINICALLY_VALIDATED and no external clinician signed it off. Anything not present in the source matrix lives under safetyPolicies or greenSafetyBlockers with its own provenance. Java and Python each carry a generated copy — never edit a copy, run DevTools/sync_triage_rule_registry.py.

releaseGates.$comment: GREEN is gated OFF by default. The current rule set covers only a subset of stage-specific danger signs, so 'no rule matched' does NOT mean 'low risk'. When greenEnabled is false, a would-be GREEN becomes NEEDS_MORE_INFO / ROUTE_TO_HEALTHCARE_WORKER.
greenEnableRequires: Stage-specific minimum dataset defined and internally reviewed
Danger-sign coverage checklist completed and recorded in internal_rule_review_manifest.json
All greenSafetyBlockers either resolved into reviewed rules or explicitly accepted as limitations
artifact_integrity_manifest.json, source_verification_manifest.json and internal_rule_review_manifest.json all consistent
Java/Python parity green across the shared vectors
Feature flag triage.v2.green-enabled deliberately switched on
NOTE: none of the above constitutes clinical validation; GREEN remains an informational orientation, not a safety guarantee

operationalDefinitions.$comment: Deterministic mapping from FIXED answer option codes (or user-supplied measurements) to signals. The LLM never decides a threshold: it may only report which option the user chose. The source matrix flags the remote-channel definition of 'nhiều' (heavy) as an unresolved item, so these thresholds are an internal working definition and are NOT clinically validated.

rules.title: Mất ý thức, co giật hoặc khó thở nghiêm trọng
Ra máu âm đạo nhiều trong thai kỳ
exclusions: Bác sĩ xác nhận định nghĩa "nhiều" cho kênh từ xa

matrixProvenance.openItem: Operational definition of HEAVY for a remote channel is unconfirmed — see operationalDefinitions.status.

rules.title: Đau đầu dữ dội kèm rối loạn thị giác trong thai kỳ
exclusions: Không chẩn đoán tiền sản giật; chỉ phân tầng nguy cơ

matrixProvenance.gestationalWeekResolution: The Matrix trigger condition contains NO gestational-week term; gestational_week appears only under 'Dữ liệu bắt buộc'. Therefore week is SUPPORTING DATA, not a trigger condition, and the rule applies at any gestational age. Recorded rather than guessed.

rules.title: Ra máu âm đạo không kèm dấu hiệu RED
exclusions: Nếu lượng máu chưa rõ hoặc mâu thuẫn → NEEDS_MORE_INFO

matrixProvenance.note: 'AND no RED rule matched' is enforced by engine precedence, not by the condition tree.

rules.title: Ra máu nhiều hoặc cục máu đông lớn sau sinh
exclusions: Không chẩn đoán băng huyết sau sinh

rules.title: Đau ngực, khó thở nghiêm trọng hoặc co giật sau sinh
Chưa đủ dữ liệu khi nghi ngờ có thai
exclusions: Nếu có bất kỳ GLOBAL/PREG RED signal → RED override

matrixProvenance.note: RED override is enforced by engine precedence.

rules.title: Thiếu trường dữ liệu bắt buộc
exclusions: RED rule luôn kiểm tra lại sau mỗi câu trả lời

matrixProvenance.note: Matrix 'Dừng hỏi' = FALSE and Action = ASK_CLARIFYING_QUESTIONS, so stopOnMatch is FALSE. Stopping after the round budget is exhausted is a RUNTIME policy (runtime.max_rounds_exhausted), not a property of this rule — see runtimePolicies.maxRoundsExhausted.

rules.title: Ngoài phạm vi sức khỏe sinh sản
exclusions: Nếu có dấu hiệu cấp cứu chung vẫn xử lý RED trước

rules.title: Chưa phát hiện dấu hiệu nguy cơ cao
exclusions: Không diễn đạt "hoàn toàn an toàn"

rules.$comment: PAEDIATRIC RULES — ported from the V1 engine (PediatricRiskRules.java), which was DEV_REVIEWED and in production. Thresholds and boolean logic carry over unchanged; the only translation is from V1's free-text field matching to typed signals, which is recorded per rule in translationNote. These are NOT new clinical content and are NOT clinically validated. matchesSnapshot is false because the v0.1.0 rule matrix snapshot predates paediatric coverage.
rules.title: Trẻ khó thở, rút lõm lồng ngực hoặc tím tái
rules.translationNote: V1 RED_BREATHING_DISTRESS matched symptoms difficulty_breathing/chest_indrawing/cyanosis and the free-text breathingStatus phrases 'kho tho', 'rut lom', 'tim tai'. Those phrases map onto SEVERE_BREATHING_DIFFICULTY, CHEST_INDRAWING and CYANOSIS respectively.

rules.title: Trẻ co giật hoặc lơ mơ, khó đánh thức
rules.translationNote: V1 RED_SEIZURE and RED_LETHARGY. V1's lethargy/difficult_to_wake map onto ALTERED_CONSCIOUSNESS, which is the canonical entity-agnostic signal for the same finding.

rules.title: Trẻ bỏ bú, không uống được hoặc nôn liên tục
rules.translationNote: V1 RED_POOR_FEEDING (poor_feeding OR unable_to_drink) and RED_PERSISTENT_VOMITING. V1's two feeding symptoms collapse onto POOR_FEEDING, which the question catalogue resolves as one field.

rules.title: Trẻ có dấu hiệu mất nước
rules.translationNote: V1 RED_DIARRHEA_DEHYDRATION (dehydration AND diarrhea) and RED_SEVERE_DEHYDRATION (severe_dehydration without diarrhea). Both collapse to: severe dehydration alone, or any dehydration together with diarrhoea.

rules.title: Trẻ dưới 3 tháng tuổi có sốt
rules.translationNote: V1 RED_INFANT_FEVER_UNDER_3_MONTHS: childAgeMonths < 3 AND temperatureC >= 38.0. Thresholds carry over exactly.

rules.title: Trẻ sốt cao, hoặc phát ban kèm sốt cao
rules.translationNote: V1 RED_HIGH_FEVER (high_fever OR temperatureC >= 39.0) and RED_RASH_HIGH_FEVER (rash AND temperatureC >= 39.0). The rash variant is subsumed: high fever alone already escalates, so rash adds no separate threshold.

rules.title: Trẻ có triệu chứng cần theo dõi
rules.translationNote: V1 YELLOW_FEVER_MONITOR, YELLOW_PERSISTENT_FEVER, YELLOW_MILD_MODERATE_DIARRHEA, YELLOW_LIMITED_VOMITING, YELLOW_MILD_RASH and YELLOW_RESPIRATORY_NO_DISTRESS. V1 raised the same YELLOW disposition for each, so they are one rule here; the RED rules above already claim the escalating variants and run first.

safetyPolicies.$comment: NOT part of the clinical Rule Matrix. These are safety behaviours inherited from V1 production that would be a REGRESSION to drop. They are deliberately kept OUTSIDE `rules` so they can never be counted as clinically approved, and each carries a review deadline.
safetyPolicies.title: Tím tái
safetyPolicies.provenance: V1 production behaviour: RED_*_CYANOSIS in UniversalMaternalRedRules.java and _MATERNAL_CYANOSIS_PHRASES in risk_rules.py. Rule Matrix v0.1.0 GLOBAL_RED_001 lists ALTERED_CONSCIOUSNESS | SEIZURE | SEVERE_BREATHING_DIFFICULTY only — cyanosis is NOT listed.
safetyPolicies.promotionRequires: Explicit clinical decision to either add CYANOSIS to GLOBAL_RED_001 in the Matrix, or to retire this policy.
limitations: Conservative behaviour inherited from V1; coverage is not exhaustive.

safetyPolicies.title: Nguy cơ tự làm hại bản thân hoặc làm hại em bé
safetyPolicies.provenance: V1 production behaviour: RED_*_SELF_HARM in UniversalMaternalRedRules.java and _MATERNAL_SELF_HARM_PHRASES in risk_rules.py. Deliberately classified as a NON-CLINICAL safety policy, not a clinical triage rule: it is a duty-of-care escalation, not a medical stratification. It is NOT in the Rule Matrix and must never be reported as clinically approved.
safetyPolicies.noExpiryReason: A duty-of-care escalation should not silently lapse. It is reviewed, never expired.
limitations: Conservative behaviour inherited from V1; coverage is not exhaustive.

greenSafetyBlockers.$comment: Signals the approved rule set does NOT yet stratify. They must NOT be auto-assigned RED or YELLOW (no approved rule exists), must NOT be named as a disease, and must BLOCK GREEN. Outcome becomes NEEDS_MORE_INFO with fixed follow-up questions where available.
greenSafetyBlockers.title: Đau đầu dữ dội chưa kèm đánh giá thị giác
limitations: Blocks GREEN only; assigns no clinical outcome.

greenSafetyBlockers.title: Dữ liệu chảy máu chưa rõ hoặc mâu thuẫn
limitations: Blocks GREEN only; assigns no clinical outcome.

greenSafetyBlockers.title: Đau bụng nghiêm trọng chưa có rule được duyệt
limitations: Blocks GREEN only; assigns no clinical outcome.

greenSafetyBlockers.title: Sốt cao hoặc dấu hiệu nhiễm trùng chưa được đánh giá
limitations: Blocks GREEN only; assigns no clinical outcome.

greenSafetyBlockers.title: Cử động thai giảm hoặc mất chưa được đánh giá
limitations: Blocks GREEN only; assigns no clinical outcome.

greenSafetyBlockers.title: Một chân sưng, đỏ hoặc đau sau sinh chưa được đánh giá
limitations: Blocks GREEN only; assigns no clinical outcome.

greenSafetyBlockers.title: Sản dịch có mùi hôi chưa được đánh giá
limitations: Blocks GREEN only; assigns no clinical outcome.

greenSafetyBlockers.title: Dữ liệu stage hoặc tuần thai mâu thuẫn
limitations: Blocks GREEN only; assigns no clinical outcome.

maxRoundsExhausted.$comment: Distinct from any rule's stopOnMatch. When the question budget is spent and the minimum dataset is still incomplete, the RUNTIME stops the conversation and re-routes the action, without altering the matched rule's own Matrix-declared flags.

governance.legacyFieldNote: rule.status still carries the value APPROVED for loader/vector compatibility. APPROVED_LEGACY_FIELD means RELEASE-ENABLED IN THIS RULESET ONLY. It does NOT mean a clinician approved the rule. Authoritative governance lives in internalReviewStatus / sourceVerificationStatus / clinicalValidationStatus and in the three manifests.
governance.legacyFieldRemovalPlan: Replace rule.status with releaseStatus (DRAFT|ACTIVE|DISABLED|RETIRED) in ruleset 3.0.0, porting Java + Python loaders and parity vectors in the same change.

ruleMatrixSource: Internal rule set built by the CareBridge development team by mapping publicly available medical guidance (WHO, Vietnamese MoH and public hospital material). Not a clinically validated instrument and not endorsed by WHO.
